basic_info.description: Inconspicuous and secure, situated behind an enormous door/ wall at the street elevation, you'll discover a hand cultivated, custom-planted garden with awning, heat lamps, trained star jasmine, fossil stepping stone, custom ironwork and more. This retreat space is adorned by the gentle backdrop of natural white noise' via bamboo water fountain. One of a kind custom view home. Inside, you'll experience a refined, custom designed, fully permitted 3 level view home.  Used as a 2 bedroom (or, 1 bedroom plus full floor loft), with 1.5 baths, the home boasts unique and sweeping views from the Golden Gate Bridge tower and Mt. Tamalpais, to the San Francisco Skyline, East Bay and more. Meticulously and tastefully reconstructed with a 3rd floor addition and ground level heated, finished space. Careful attention to every detail was considered by the owners in cultivating a distinctive home inspired by Asian and worldly lifestyle influences employing materials and techniques that are worthy of appreciation.
